name: Campingplatz Elbsee
beschreibung: The Elbsee campsite in Ruderatshofen is located directly on the shore of Elbsee and at the foot of the Alpen, in the border region with Tirol, Österreich. The quiet, unspoiled surroundings are ideal for extensive hikes and cycling tours in the surrounding area. The campsite's facilities include modern sanitary facilities, a kiosk, and its own beach access to the lake with a swimming area. The spacious pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents offer ample comfort and privacy. The atmosphere at the campsite is close to nature and relaxed, which makes it especially popular with families with children and those seeking relaxation. The target audience is primarily nature lovers and active holidaymakers, who appreciate the proximity to the region's sights as well as the adjacent Tiroler Außerfern.
